name: openbao
description: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys.
one_liner: Free, open-source software for safely storing and handing out passwords, API keys, and certificates to other software, so secrets aren't scattered in plain text files.
buyer: An IT lead at a mid-size company who wants to stop paying for (or trusting) a commercial secrets-management vendor and self-host their own instead.
business_use_cases: A company migrates off an expensive commercial secrets-management license onto a self-hosted instance to cut licensing costs.
A managed-hosting provider offers 'secrets management as a service' built on it for clients who don't want to run it themselves.
A security consultancy includes it in a hardening engagement for a client storing API keys insecurely in code or spreadsheets.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a managed/hosted version with support for companies that don't want to run it themselves.
Paid migration and hardening consulting for companies moving off insecure secret storage.

steal_this: Set it up this weekend for one small business still storing API keys in a spreadsheet or Slack messages, and charge a flat fee for the migration.
